0022600020.text: The Miami Heat, 1-4 and 13th in the East, host the Indiana Pacers in their sixth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, with Miami yet to win at home (0-3). Indiana, at 2-3 and 10th in the East, is 2-1 on the road but has lost its last two games, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Heat lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 135-118 defeat in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026. Miami is without Simone Fontecchio, who is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, with Aaron Nesmith and Andrew Nembhard listed as day-to-day.
